answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity with decaying trust: each agent posts a bond of opal tokens that slashes on proven fraud, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. New agents start like a willow sapling with limited rights - they can transact small amounts but cannot vote or attest - and only earn full privileges after months of honest work. Reputation then grows like a vine: each verified interaction adds a link anchored on-chain, so a sybil ring cannot cheaply clone that history, because buying a mature vine costs more than the attack gains.
